tag: Sprint 14 Task E, F117 (F114 cloud read)

laser-wavelengths-pulses: Experimental setup, p.2: laser, WDM wavelengths and beam waists stated as the authors' own setup
slm-specs: Experimental setup, p.2: SLM model, pitch, active area and digit-on-SLM1 protocol stated
ppln-crystal: Experimental setup p.2 and Fig. 1 caption: PPLN poling period, length, doping, efficiency and SF wavelength stated
msic-definition: Introduction, p.1: the paper defines MSIC at first use, in the quoted sentence and the one after it
hybrid-architecture: Introduction, p.1: states what the hybrid MSIC plus DNN architecture does, 40 LG pump modes, power per mode into the DNN
lg-mode-selection: Experimental setup, pp.2-3: 110 simulated modes, 40 chosen by simulated accuracy; the selection protocol is stated
dnn-architecture: Experimental setup, p.2: layer counts and sizes stated in one paragraph
dnn-training-config: Experimental setup, p.2: ReLU, categorical cross entropy (Eq. 1), ADAM stated
dataset-split: Experimental setup, p.3: dataset, resize and 4800/1200 split stated; this fixes what the benchmark covers
feature-normalization-input: Experimental setup, p.3: normalization on the training set, 4x10 mapping and GPU stated
data-collection-procedures: Experiment, p.3: sequential and loop runs defined in two sentences
noise-model: Noise test, p.3: cluster size, phase distribution and 40% coverage stated
snr-definition: Noise test, p.3, Eq. (2): SNR defined by the paper with its variance terms
speed-limit-slm: Experiment, p.3: authors state the SLM-limited speed, 1.5 s pause and days to measure all MNIST
drift-limit: Experiment, p.3: authors state drift, fluctuation and noise errors that reduce accuracy over days
hardware-vesuvius-isi: Experimental methods, p.5: processor, site, 512 bits in 8x8 cells and tf = 20 us stated
hardware-uncalibrated-cells: Experimental methods, p.5: nine bits out of calibration and cells containing them not used
hardware-acknowledgement-vendor-support: Acknowledgements, p.12: funding, machine access and D-Wave-supplied BTE solver stated; the BTE tooling is part of the computational setup (the text says D-Wave Two there and Vesuvius in Methods)
def-map-mpm: Introduction, p.1: the paper describes MAP and MPM in the two numbered items as the terms it uses; the history clause cites [1-3] but the descriptions are given as definitions
def-ising-code-sourlas: Introduction, Ising Code, p.2: the code the paper uses is described with N bits, N spins and M>N couplers; attributed to Sourlas but given as the object used
scope-thermal-fluctuations-not-quantum: Introduction, p.2: the paper states it does not seek the role of quantum fluctuations
setup-chip-hamiltonian: Programmable Annealer, Eqs. 2-3, pp.2-3: the Hamiltonian, programmable parameters and alpha stated as the model of the device used
setup-chimera-connectivity: Programmable Annealer, p.3 and Fig. 1 caption: Chimera graph, two-local couplers, eight spins per unit cell
setup-encoding-trivial-message-gauge: Programmable Annealer, p.3: encoding on conventional resources and the all-ones word by gauge symmetry stated
setup-fields-transmitted-break-z2: Programmable Annealer, p.3: the encoding scheme sending fields hi = 2Xi - 1 with the couplers is stated as the paper's protocol
setup-code-parameters-single-cell: Macroscopic Analysis p.5, Fig. 2 caption and Table 1: N = 8, M = 16, rate 0.333 (8/24) all stated
setup-code-parameters-4x4: Macroscopic Analysis p.8, Fig. 5 caption and Table 1: 128 bits and 352 couplers stated; the stated rate 0.276 differs from N/(N+M) = 0.267 but is what the paper prints (a paper inconsistency worth flagging)
setup-binary-symmetric-channel: Programmable Annealer, Eq. 4, p.4: channel model and Nishimori temperature stated
setup-finite-t-decoding-eq5: Programmable Annealer, Eq. 5, p.4: finite temperature decoding defined, ML as the special case
setup-nishimori-varied-at-encoding: Programmable Annealer, p.4: the protocol of varying TNish at encoding with fixed machine temperature stated
setup-analytic-model-spin-sign-def: Programmable Annealer, p.4: exhaustive-sum Boltzmann model and the spin-sign transition temperature term defined
setup-gauge-and-ber-definition: Experimental methods, Eq. 6, p.5: random gauge mapping and bit-error-rate defined
setup-ber-sum-over-corruption-count: Supplement Sec. 1, Eqs. 10-12: the grouping into N+M+1 sector averages is derived in full; the remark on a representative sample is an approximation remark, not proved
setup-alpha-as-temperature-knob: Macroscopic Analysis, p.5: the method of mimicking temperature by alpha stated
claim-macro-vs-micro-need: Microscopic Analysis, pp.8-9: the authors state what the macroscopic result does not establish and that the microscopic analysis is application independent; both are statements about the paper's own coverage
def-spin-sign-transition: Microscopic theory, p.9: spin-sign transition defined, with the trivial no-transition case
def-p-low-experimental: Microscopic theory, pp.9-10: low-temperature decoding (as a limit) and P_low defined
scope-why-p-low-is-continuous: Microscopic theory, p.10: the authors give their two reasons for the P_low protocol; the non-convergence remark is their explanation of control errors, stated as part of the method rationale
setup-4x4-bte-and-exclusion: Microscopic theory, p.10 and Supplement Sec. 4: BTE method and exclusion of zero-ground-state spins stated
limit-spurious-transitions-excluded: Supplement Sec. 4, p.15: the authors state their method finds spurious transitions for zero ground state spins and exclude them
def-perr-metrics-same-and-different-t: Microscopic theory, Eqs. 8-9, pp.10-11: both performance measures defined, with the at-least-one-transition restriction
result-4x4-sampled-hamiltonians-setup: Fig. 7 caption, p.12: alpha, 145 Hamiltonians, 200 flips, 100 sets of 1000 cycles, T/(aJ) = 1.405 stated
setup-fig8-simulation-parameters: Fig. 8 caption, p.12: BTE control error, SA updates, sweep start and sample count stated
limit-sa-shifted-transition-unexplained: Microscopic results, p.12: the authors state the shifted SA transition, give a suspected cause and say further study is out of scope
setup-supp-fig-s2-histogram: Supplement Sec. 3, Fig. S2 caption, p.14: sample and exclusion stated
limit-quantum-role-untested: Conclusion, p.13: the authors state the work treats the processor as a classical thermal device and the quantum role remains untested
chen2017-qzb-definition: Introduction, p.2: the paper defines QZB in the quoted sentence
chen2017-device-geometry: Section 1, pp.4-5 and Methods: z-cut LNOI, 500 nm etched to 200 nm, radius about 20 um stated
chen2017-d31-d32-limitation: Section 1, p.5: the authors state the d31/d32 disadvantage of z-cut and that poling is future work
chen2017-fiber-taper-loss: Section 1, pp.5-6: the authors state their tapered fiber coupler's loss and positioning sensitivity
chen2017-optical-setup-channels: Section 2, p.8, Fig. 4 caption: the three channels' rates and widths stated
chen2017-pump-signal-powers: Section 2, p.9: operating powers and wavelength tuning stated
chen2017-extinction-definition: Section 2, p.9: modulation extinction defined by the paper
chen2017-pulse-design-thermal-control: Section 2, pp.11-13 and Fig. 6 caption: repetition rates, 10 ps alignment and 300 ps displacement stated
chen2017-single-photon-mode-choice-limit: Section 3, p.14: authors state the filter-limited mode choice and that it more than halves QZB efficiency
chen2017-single-photon-detection-setup: Section 3, p.14: DWDM filters, detector and 2 million pulse averaging stated
chen2017-noise-derivation-method: Section 3, pp.14-15: noise derivation method, fiber lengths and 8.6% efficiency stated
chen2017-single-photon-input-and-backgro: Section 3, pp.16-17: 0.16 photons per pulse and the 7.12 KHz subtracted background stated
chen2017-sfg-stabilization-method: Methods, pp.18-19: the stabilization procedure stated
waveguide-geometry: Section II, p.4: the optimized cross section stated as the paper's design
poling-period-4um: Section II, p.5: the poling period of about 4 um is the design value, and the fabrication text uses a small poling period (about 4 um)
qpm-type0-d33: Section II, p.3: the paper's design uses type-0 QPM with TE modes to use d33 on X-cut
lnoi-wafer-stack: Section II, p.5: wafer stack stated
spdc-detection-setup: Section III.B, p.8: detectors and filters stated
spdc-pump-and-temperature: Section III.B, p.8: pump laser and chip temperature stated

theory_low.result-analytic-lowT-ml-better-highnoise: Calculation on one small instance family with a qualitative authors' conclusion; not a theorem with a proof, Fig. 3, pp.5-6
theory_low.result-supp-nishimori-check-on-fig3: A numerical check on one calculation shown in Fig. S1; the Nishimori result is cited from [27,28], not proved here
theory_low.result-plateau-and-discontinuities-spin-: Authors' observation on a figure; the size scaling rests on simulations the text says are 'not shown', p.6
theory_low.proved-all-satisfiable-no-transitions: Stated with 'for example this must be true' and no proof or argument given, p.9
theory_low.theory-boltzmann-step-function-expected: Eq. 7 is obtained by the central limit theorem but the derivation is not shown and it is an approximation; the step-function statement is an expectation, p.10
theory_low.result-single-cell-no-multiple-transitio: A computed property of the single-cell family stated without the enumeration shown, p.10
theory_low.result-supp-size-scaling: A calculation on one truncated graph shown in figures; the size-scaling conclusion is the authors' inference, Supplement Sec. 3
theory_low.mode-overlap-over-90: A simulation outcome (design target from simulations), no figures or method shown in this passage, Section II, p.3
theory_low.pump-wavelength-from-shg: A simulation result (Sellmeier and Lumerical) and an inference from it, Section II, p.4
